caption:
Koko nodded along in the session, then got home and the questions arrived. Good questions make your plan clearer and easier to stick to.

Try asking: What do you think is going on? What's fine to keep doing, and what should I ease back on for now? How will we measure progress? What's a rough timeframe, and when do we review the plan?

Flare-ups are common and usually settle, so ask what to scale back and when to get in touch rather than wait. If a term sounds like jargon, ask what it means.

Our team at Hybrid Physio welcomes questions at every visit. Jot them in your phone before you arrive. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
